name: Welcome Modal UI
description: UI sub-spec for the startup workspace selection dialog: branding, recent workspace list with remove buttons, and action buttons.

children: .welcome-recent: title + list of .welcome-recent-item (path + X remove button)

interactions.behavior: Selects the workspace path and closes modal, returning the path
Calls workspace.removeRecent(path), removes item from list, hides recent section if empty
Opens native folder picker via workspace.select(); closes modal with selected path

states.name: with-recents
states.description: Recent workspace list visible with clickable items and X remove buttons

states.name: no-recents
states.description: Recent section hidden, only Open Workspace and Close buttons visible

states.name: missing-path
states.description: Recent item with missing directory shows dimmed text (opacity 0.4)
